title: B-pwa + B-login: customer PWA shell + phone-code login
coverage_delta: +60 tests across 11 new test files (all customer-PWA); full web suite 104 files / 687 tests green. No files deleted; no existing tests changed.
notes: Both B-pwa and B-login complete, strict red-green-refactor. Quality gate ALL green: tsc clean, lint --max-warnings 0 clean (fixed a prefer-const and swapped CodeInput autoFocus prop for programmatic ref.focus to satisfy jsx-a11y/no-autofocus), vitest 684 pass, build OK, size 198.08 KB brotli < 260 KB budget. KEY DECISIONS: (1) CRITICAL skipAuthRedirect:true on requestCustomerCode + verifyCustomerCode — verify-code returns 401 on wrong code and request-code 429 on rate-limit; without the flag client.ts would redirect/clear storage and destroy the Czech form errors (verified: mocked 401 surfaces to the hook catch, not a redirect). (2) F-05 slug: resolveFleetSlug(hostname,search,pathname) order = subdomain -> ?fleet= -> /c/f/{slug} path -> 'demo' default; extracted ensureFleetSlug() (resolve+persist via newly-added authStorage.setFleetSlug) called inside a useState INITIALIZER (runs during render, before the branding/auth query fetch effects) so public/* never 404s on localhost; re-resolved every mount because clear() wipes the slug. IMPORTANT: /c/login is a router SIBLING of CustomerLayout (not a child), so CustomerLoginPage calls ensureFleetSlug() too — a direct hit to /c/login would otherwise fire request-code with no X-Fleet-Slug and 404. Covered by CustomerLayout.test.tsx + ensureFleetSlug.test.ts (the mocked-client login tests cannot catch a missing slug). (3) Inline-login surface: useCustomerLogin({onAuthenticated}) + CustomerLoginStep never navigate themselves — standalone CustomerLoginPage passes ()=>navigate('/c'); order WIs (B-route-order/B-custom-order) pass a resume-create continuation so form state is preserved. On success: authStorage.setTokens + idbAuthStore.setRefreshToken + enableSilentRefresh('/c/login') + scheduleProactiveRefresh (never re-ask on device). (4) Branding via nested ThemeProvider in CustomerLayout; applyFleetBranding maps primaryColorHex (#RRGGBB else theme fallback). (5) PWA: single vite-plugin-pwa manifest already covers /c (scope '/', globs precache the lazy /c chunks) — no vite.config.ts change needed; devOptions.enabled stays false, no ^/api|^/hubs runtime cache. Limitation noted: installed app start_url is still /d. (6) Code-splitting verified: CustomerLayout/HomePage/LoginPage build to own small chunks, no Leaflet in the shell/home chunks. REUSED (no fork): shared/api/client.ts, auth-storage, idbAuthStore, refresh.ts (silent refresh), i18n, theme, axe helper. KNOWN EDGE (documented in CLAUDE.md, not hit by ACs): client.ts double-401 _isRetry branch hardcodes /d/login regardless of role; customer terminal refresh failure correctly uses refresh.ts configurable /c/login. CustomerHomePage is a B-pwa placeholder (shell + OfflineGate only); B-home fills it in. Did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state pipeline. All new i18n keys added to BOTH cs.json and en.json (parity green), formal Czech 'vy'.
verification_output: tsc: clean. lint: clean (--max-warnings 0). vitest: Test Files 104 passed (104), Tests 687 passed (687). build: OK, PWA precache 17 entries; customer chunks (CustomerLayout / CustomerHomePage / CustomerLoginPage / useFleetBranding) split out; no Leaflet in shell/home chunks. size: 198.22 kB brotlied (limit 260 kB).
